about: Which host-declared <send> / <invoke> types SCE refuses, written out by hand.
A type is reserved when it starts with `sce:` - the prefix SCE keeps for
the processors it defines itself (`sce:mesh`, `sce:mesh-rpc`). A host
declaring or registering one would replace SCE's processor with nothing
on the wire saying so. The rule is the leading prefix, spelled exactly:
a name that merely contains it, or spells it in another case, is a
The same answer is computed at build time by
host_processor_analyzer::check_host_declarations and at run time by each
runtime's event-processor and invoker registration. Every copy reads
this table, so a type one of them refuses is one they all refuse.
